purpose: Add actual Leiden resolution-1 labels from the existing saved corrected and uncorrected neighbor graphs without recomputing UMAP or reading raw matrices in the preview builder.

current_view.state: actual verified initial partitions available; final QC and independent labels pending
current_view.initial_uncorrected_activity: unavailable; never reuses corrected marker means

required_producer_evidence: actual job ID and unique successful terminal accounting
matching execution, stage and storage completion receipts
frozen producer source manifest and actual runtime versions
identity of the saved corrected and uncorrected graphs used
actual Leiden implementation, resolution=1.0, seed and settings
explicit whether only partition labels changed or any graph changed; never imply a new embedding when coordinates are reused

cell_axis.hash_convention: UTF-8 exact cell ID plus newline for every row in saved source order
required_checks: each nucleus has one valid label per available graph
all label and composition counts reconcile
no change in retained-cell membership for this additive resolution comparison

resolution_dataset.dataset_id: must identify the actual new producer and resolution
resolution_dataset.corrected_labels: One dictionary-coded actual per-cell label per saved source row; codes are dictionary indices, not assumed biological identities.
resolution_dataset.uncorrected_labels: Separate actual partition from the saved uncorrected graph; do not copy corrected labels into the comparator.
resolution_dataset.point_attributes: Supply a versioned typed-array label file or separate resolution-specific vectors. Existing point_attributes.js is explicitly resolution-0.6 and cannot serve as resolution-1 labels.
resolution_dataset.dtype: Declare uint8/uint16/uint32 according to actual label dictionary size. Validate byte length and finite integer codes.
resolution_dataset.coordinates: May reference the existing real Harmony and uncorrected UMAP coordinate adapters after exact cell-axis matching. Changing color labels does not recompute UMAP.

composition_adapter.calculation: Count actual resolution-1 per-cell labels within the unchanged animal axis. Animal/condition denominators remain all initial nuclei in the selected animals, never resolution-0.6 cluster sizes.
invariants: sum of uncorrected cluster counts=456472 if produced
sum within each animal matches accepted initial metadata
no biological cluster matching is implied by the same numeric cluster label at a different resolution

marker_adapter.availability_gate: Resolution-1 marker plots stay unavailable until resolution-1-specific summaries are actually produced and validated.
marker_adapter.normalization: Use the declared full-cell activity denominator and same documented units. Preserve raw integer activity separately.
marker_adapter.coverage: n_cells must agree with the actual resolution-1 animal x cluster counts. Missing mapped features, empty groups and unsupported combinations are explicit NA/absence, not zero-filled fabricated activity.
marker_adapter.selected_panel: If the same 107 diagnostic genes are summarized, mark them as a selected panel. They do not become unbiased top markers or final cell-type markers.
prohibited: renaming 0.6 cluster IDs to pretend they are 1.0
using 0.6 marker means for new 1.0 clusters
propagating initial candidate cell-type labels by numeric cluster ID
claiming differential biology from a finer partition

UI_adoption.label_views_ready: With validated actual labels and axis, enable the 1.0 option for UMAP colors and composition. State clearly that the displayed UMAP coordinates are reused saved coordinates.
UI_adoption.marker_views_pending: If label views are ready before marker summaries, resolution-1 dotplots and animal activity boxes must show a pending state. The 0.6 activity data must not remain silently displayed under a 1.0 heading.
UI_adoption.marker_views_ready: Enable dotplot/boxplot only after resolution-specific marker validation. Recompute equal-animal summaries from those rows.
UI_adoption.display_labels: Store resolution-specific mappings keyed by dataset and resolution so a 0.6 browser mapping is not automatically applied to 1.0 labels.
UI_adoption.exports: PDF figure titles and context must include the selected resolution, graph and actual source producer. TSV/JSON includes resolution and graph. No visible PNG plot export.
UI_adoption.cell_type_status: All partitions remain provisional; no automatic final identities or exclusions. Preserve every cell type for independent review.
